title: PaRAGraph Casebook: source-grounded cases in Yue dialect classification and tone inventories
description:
Companion casebook to the PaRAGraph article: four source-grounded cases in Yue (Cantonese) dialectology (C1–C4). Each case pairs a short narrative with the slice of the PaRAGraph knowledge graph behind it — claims, quoted evidence and sources — and a set of graph operations that the static viewer recomputes in the browser and compares with results recorded on the production graph.

Live: https://www.sciencerag.win/casebook
